purpose: Four minimal-text marketing posters explaining supported simt-dev architecture and agent workflows.
scope: Current capabilities. Research targets and proposed remote-work features are not represented as demonstrated results.

assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one finished premium marketing poster for the real developer tool simt-dev. Wide landscape composition, approximately 1536x1024. This is a beautiful designed campaign image, not a screenshot, slide deck, wireframe, or dense infographic. Art direction: a sophisticated fusion of Swiss editorial typography, experimental 3D sculpture, luminous translucent materials and crisp graphic design. Strong deliberate hierarchy, spectacular harmonious color, large negative space, generously sized highly readable type, sparse explanatory copy. Brand name must be exactly lowercase "simt-dev". Consistent palette family: midnight ink #101127, electric lilac #AA8CFF, mint #80F2C4, persimmon coral #FF765E, warm ivory #FFF4E5. Each image has one hero object and one clear message. Use text only from the exact approved strings below, each rendered once, with perfect spelling. Do not add statistics, performance promises, invented benchmarks, vendor logos, fake terminals, watermarks, illegible code, paragraphs, dense cards, or extra text. Make it artistic and surprising while the conceptual connections remain visually intelligible.
Concept: ONE DETERMINISTIC CORE, MANY DOORS. A sculptural luminous optical prism/precision engine floating in a rich midnight field. Three distinct input ribbons of coral, mint and violet enter from the left, representing repository rules, skills and decisions. Inside a precise cutaway transparent central prism, a small orderly connected lattice represents deterministic selection. The three ribbons flow through one central engine, then fan out into exactly three distinct elegant portals to the right, labeled CLI, MCP, Hooks. It should read left to right immediately: repository knowledge -> single core -> three interfaces. The same functions power each interface; this is not three different AI models. Design the core as a breathtaking faceted solid with beautiful refracted light and clean fine engineering details, not a generic brain or robot. Integrate one thin visual path for each route. Huge ivory headline in the open upper left, small brand at upper margin, tiny feature line in footer.
Exact text:
"simt-dev"
"One core.
Many doors."
"Rules · Skills · Decisions"
"CLI"
"MCP"
"Hooks"
"Deterministic · Local-first · Zero runtime dependencies"
Keep labels legible, around 5-6 total text groups. No generic UI panels.

Concept: CONTEXT JUST IN TIME. Make a spectacular floating kinetic sculpture: a large constellation of small luminous file-like tiles and thin mint/lilac code-graph connections sweeps in a controlled spiral across the left and lower center. Only a small relevant route glows brightly in coral, traveling through the graph into a single beautiful translucent mint task-brief card on the right. The many quiet graph nodes remain dark and understated; the selected route is visually obvious. On the brief card, show exactly three substantial readable rows, each paired with a beautiful tiny simple icon: Files, Tests, Decisions. Below the card, a single delicate outgoing line goes to a tiny abstract cursor/agent spark, implying the agent receives context before acting. The art communicates selection and relevant context, not data compression or removal of files. Use a warm ivory background with oversized soft lilac translucent discs and strong charcoal typography; richly shaded mint and coral glossy graph pieces; high-end science museum meets editorial cover. Large headline top left; brand tiny top margin, command in small but readable monospace bottom.

"simt-dev"
"Give agents
a sense of direction."
"Local code graph → Task brief"
"Files"
"Tests"
"Decisions"
"simt brief \"<task>\""
Keep headline elegant and commanding, not crowded. No extra legends, numeric metrics or paragraphs.

Concept: DUAL GATES THAT EXECUTE REPOSITORY POLICY. A bold supergraphic architectural landscape in warm persimmon coral and electric lilac, on an almost black ink background. A single luminous mint action path travels clearly LEFT TO RIGHT through TWO monumental sculptural translucent checkpoints in series, like two precision architectural arches on a floating plinth. First portal lavender, second coral. Label the first portal "Before tools" and second "At Git time". A small visual branch at the first checkpoint diverts a coral token into a rounded side bay with a simple pause icon; the main mint path continues through the second gate to an abstract ivory repository cube carrying a small mint check mark. Communicate checking at two moments, not an impenetrable security perimeter and not universal protection of every agent action. Use meticulous studio lighting, glossy clay/glass materials, physically plausible soft shadows, extreme clean composition, two portal labels directly anchored and easy to read, hero image occupying lower two thirds and powerful headline upper left. This is beautiful architecture with a conceptual path, not a generic cyber-security shield ad.
Exact text:
"simt-dev"
"Rules that act."
"Before tools"
"At Git time"
"Two checkpoints. Your repository’s checks."
Small brand upper margin. Headline very large. No other words or invented shell commands.

Concept: EVIDENCE AND REVIEWED LESSONS COMPLETE THE FEEDBACK LOOP. A warm light ivory editorial poster with a breathtaking large sculptural LOOP made of four visibly distinct broad translucent ribbons of mint, electric lilac, coral and pale butter yellow, floating as a gently tilted almost-circular toroidal kinetic sculpture. Four rounded stations orbit the loop, balanced spaciously, and each has one simple tactile icon: test flask for Test, receipt with check for Record, book/lightbulb for Learn, compact task card for Brief. Place four small understated arrowheads at the natural curve to read clockwise Test -> Record -> Learn -> Brief -> Test. The center of the ring remains mostly empty so the shape feels airy, not dense. A tiny precise human review stamp icon beside the learning node indicates lessons are reviewed, not an autonomous model rewriting policies. The loop represents reuse of test evidence and promoted lessons in future briefs; do not imply guaranteed self-improvement or measured uplift. Print "Reviewed lessons → Future briefs" as the single explanatory footer line. Large dark headline top left, small brand top margin. Bright sophisticated color with luminous glass, subtle grain, elegant deep charcoal serif-free editorial typography. This should feel like a collectible design poster, not a four-box business workflow.
Exact text:
"simt-dev"
"Make experience
useful."
"Test"
"Record"
"Learn"
"Brief"
"Reviewed lessons → Future briefs"
No other text, no charts, no numerical performance claims.
